```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(knitr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
raw <- read.csv("asimplied.csv", check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dep <- format(strptime(raw$SOBT, "%d-%m-%Y %H:%M"), "%H%M")
corpus <- data.frame(flight = raw[["Flight Designator"]],
                     n      = raw[["S.no"]],
                     route  = raw[["Routing"]],
                     dest   = raw[["dest_iata"]],
                     cap    = raw[["Seats"]],
                     dep    = dep,
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
corpus <- corpus[order(corpus$n), ]

# --- Model M1 parameters (first model column of seats.xlsx) ---
mean_before <- 150   # minutes before departure (mean entry)
sigma       <- 30    # minutes (standard deviation)
LF          <- 1     # load factor for M1

hhmm <- function(m) {            # minutes-of-day (any integer) -> "HHMM", wrapped to 24h
  m <- ((round(m) %% 1440) + 1440) %% 1440
  sprintf("%02d%02d", m %/% 60L, m %% 60L)
}
endlab <- function(v) if (v == 1440L) "2400" else hhmm(v)   # show end of day as 2400
```

```{r comp, results='asis'}
depm   <- as.integer(substr(corpus$dep, 1, 2)) * 60L + as.integer(substr(corpus$dep, 3, 4))
mu_all <- (((depm - mean_before) %% 1440L) + 1440L) %% 1440L   # mean entry clock time, wrapped to the day
pax    <- round(LF * corpus$cap)
A_all  <- pax * 10 / (sigma * sqrt(2 * pi))                    # per-flight peak, pax per 10 min

# Each panel is drawn in plain TikZ (light): manual axes + one polyline per flight.
legend_plain <- function() {
  cat("\\par\\vspace{3pt}{\\centering\\scriptsize ")
  cat("\\textcolor{black}{\\rule[0.35ex]{2.6ex}{1.1pt}}\\,one flight (M1 entry rate, pax / 10 min)")
  cat("\\par}\n")
}
panel <- function(W0, W1, lab) {
  sel  <- which(mu_all >= W0 & mu_all < W1)
  span <- W1 - W0
  step <- if (span <= 480L) 60L else if (span <= 720L) 120L else 180L
  Wcm  <- 15.5; Hcm <- 7.0                 # plot-area size in cm
  sx   <- Wcm / span                       # cm per minute
  sy   <- Hcm / 100                        # cm per (pax / 10 min)
  xc   <- function(m) (m - W0) * sx
  yc   <- function(v) v * sy

  cat("\\begin{figure}[H]\n\\centering\n\\begin{tikzpicture}\n")
  cat(sprintf("\\draw[->] (0,0) -- (%.3f,0);\n", Wcm + 0.4))   # time axis
  cat(sprintf("\\draw[->] (0,0) -- (0,%.3f);\n", Hcm + 0.4))   # count axis
  for (v in seq(0L, 100L, 10L)) {                              # y ticks
    cat(sprintf("\\draw (-0.07,%.3f) -- (0.07,%.3f);\n", yc(v), yc(v)))
    cat(sprintf("\\node[left, font=\\footnotesize] at (-0.10,%.3f) {%d};\n", yc(v), v))
  }
  for (t in seq(W0, W1, by = step)) {                          # x ticks (HHMM)
    cat(sprintf("\\draw (%.3f,-0.07) -- (%.3f,0.07);\n", xc(t), xc(t)))
    cat(sprintf("\\node[below, font=\\footnotesize] at (%.3f,-0.07) {%s};\n", xc(t), endlab(t)))
  }
  for (j in sel) {                                             # one polyline per flight
    m0 <- max(W0, mu_all[j] - 90L); m1 <- min(W1, mu_all[j] + 90L)
    ms <- seq(m0, m1, length.out = 28)
    ys <- A_all[j] * exp(-((ms - mu_all[j])^2) / (2 * sigma^2))
    pts <- paste(sprintf("(%.3f,%.3f)", xc(ms), yc(ys)), collapse = " ")
    cat(sprintf("\\draw[black, opacity=0.45, line width=0.3pt] plot coordinates {%s};\n", pts))
  }
  cat("\\end{tikzpicture}\n")
  legend_plain()
  cat(sprintf(paste0("\\caption{Composite M1 entry-time distributions, %s. All %d flights with mean entry ",
                     "in the window; vertical axis pax per 10 min on a fixed 0 to 100 scale.}\n"),
              lab, length(sel)))
  cat("\\end{figure}\n\\clearpage\n")
}

# 1) Four-hour windows (0000-0400, ... , 2000-2400)
for (k in 0:5) panel(k*240L, (k+1)*240L,
                     sprintf("%s to %s (4 h window)", hhmm(k*240L), endlab((k+1)*240L)))

# 2) Eight-hour windows (0000-0800, 0800-1600, 1600-2400)
for (k in 0:2) panel(k*480L, (k+1)*480L,
                     sprintf("%s to %s (8 h window)", hhmm(k*480L), endlab((k+1)*480L)))

# 3) Twelve-hour windows (0000-1200, 1200-2400)
for (k in 0:1) panel(k*720L, (k+1)*720L,
                     sprintf("%s to %s (12 h window)", hhmm(k*720L), endlab((k+1)*720L)))

# 4) Full 24-hour day
panel(0L, 1440L, "0000 to 2400 (24 h, full day)")
```
